title: About
oneLiner: A computer engineering student in Mumbai who would rather build it than describe it.
claim: I like the part of a project where the idea stops being a plan and starts being something you can break.

media.alt: Arpit Singh standing by the sea at sunset

proof.architecture: Most of what is on this line was built outside of class: a renderer with no graphics API, a streaming protocol in TypeScript, a warehouse that reports its own negative results. The through-line is systems work that has to survive contact with real traffic.
